title: Guid.CreateSequentialGuid in AL
summary: Dynamics 365 Business Central 2025 Wave 2 introduces Guid.CreateSequentialGuid, a new AL statement that generates sequential GUIDs instead of random ones, reducing index fragmentation and improving performance for GUID-based keys and systemId fields without requiring SQL roundtrips.
key_points: Sequential GUIDs reduce index fragmentation and page splits compared to randomly generated GUIDs from CreateGuid
Generation happens at middleware (session) level, eliminating unnecessary roundtrips to SQL Server
Developers should replace CreateGuid with CreateSequentialGuid in new implementations or refactored code
Sequential GUIDs are placed contiguously during I/O operations, improving performance in writing, reading, and index maintenance

quotes.text: sequential GUID will be created at NST level (in the middle tier) - no useless roundtrip to SQL
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the architectural advantage of the new feature: eliminating database roundtrips improves performance

quotes.text: indexes are reduced in fragmentation compared to randomly generated GUIDs
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights the core benefit: sequential GUIDs maintain index integrity better than random ones
